focus: پیشرفته ۱ · جلسه پانزدهم · remember to do / doing

sentences.fa: يه اشتباهي کردم، از دستم دلخور مي شي.
sentences.en: I have made a mistake; you will be annoyed with me.

sentences.fa: رو چه حسابي اين حرف رو مي زني؟ تو کاري نکردي.
sentences.en: What makes you say that? You haven't done anything wrong.

sentences.fa: فکرش رو نمي کردم مقصري.
sentences.en: I wouldn't think you were guilty.

sentences.fa: يادته قرار بود برات اينجا يه کاري جور کنم؟
sentences.en: Do you remember I was supposed to create a job for you here?

sentences.fa: به هر دري زدم برات يه کاري جور کنم ولي نتونستم.
sentences.en: I was at pains to create a job for you but I couldn't do that.

sentences.fa: تو حق نداري با من اينطوري رفتار کني.
sentences.en: You haven't got such a right to treat me like this.

sentences.fa: پدرم در اومد تا اينجا استخدامت کنم.
sentences.en: I have sold one of my kidneys to employ you here.

sentences.fa: رو چه حسابي بهش اعتماد مي کني؟
sentences.en: What makes you trust him?

sentences.fa: ده ساله باهاش کار مي کنم، بهش اعتماد دارم.
sentences.en: I have been working with him for 10 years, I trust him.

sentences.fa: بالاخره هر چي باشه ما با هم همکاريم.
sentences.en: After all we are colleagues.

sentences.fa: داشتي روم حساب مي کردي اينجا برات کاري جور کنم.
sentences.en: You were counting on me to create a job for you here.

sentences.fa: قول مي دم دست و بالت رو يه جا بند کنم.
sentences.en: I promise I will go to bat for you in my company.

sentences.fa: يادت نمي ره؟
sentences.en: You are not forgetting it?

sentences.fa: يادت مي آد قرار بود موضوع پيش خودمون باشه؟
sentences.en: Did you remember we were supposed to keep this matter under our hat?

sentences.fa: من سوتي دادم.
sentences.en: I have let the cat out of the bag.

sentences.fa: پيش مي آد، گذشته ها گذشته.
sentences.en: These things happen, let by gones be by gones.

sentences.fa: يعني مي خواي بگي از دستم دلخور نيستي.
sentences.en: You mean to say you aren't annoyed with me.

sentences.fa: مسأله اي نيست، پيش مي آد.
sentences.en: It's ok, These things happen.

sentences.fa: کار بدي کردم پدرت دلخور مي شه.
sentences.en: I have done something wrong, your father will be annoyed me.

sentences.fa: رو چه حسابي رو پدرم اينطوري فکر مي کني؟
sentences.en: What makes you think about my father like this?

sentences.fa: مي دوني، قرار بود حقوقمون رو زياد کنه، زد زير قولش.
sentences.en: You know, he was supposed to increase my salary but he has let me down.

sentences.fa: شروع کنيم؟ شروع کنيم. سؤالي نداري؟ سؤالي ندارم. شروع کنيم
sentences.en: Shall we start? Let's start. Have you got any question? I haven't got any question. Let's start.

words.en: I have sold one of my kidneys to employ here.

words.en: I promise I will go to bat for you in my company.

words.en: We were supposed to keep this matter under our hat?

I have let the cat out of the bag.
